# Commit to the repository it was pointed at

`write.repository.project` — **write** × **repository** at **project** reach (the working tree or workspace it was pointed at). Family: code. Effect: **recoverable from a backup, a history or a revert, at a cost**.

## Granted by 4 of 9

| Profile | Control on the path | Evidence | Via |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Claude Code — web container](../../../map/grants/anthropic/claude-code-remote/ccr-container/index.md) | ● none | observed | shell (Bash) |
| [Claude Code — local · confirm off](../../../map/grants/anthropic/claude-code/local-confirmations-off/index.md) | ● none | derived | shell (Bash) |
| [Claude Code — local · confirm on](../../../map/grants/anthropic/claude-code/local-default/index.md) | ● none | derived | shell (Bash) |
| [GitHub Actions — hosted runner](../../../map/grants/github/actions-runner/ci/index.md) | ○ boundary | observed | the job's shell |

## What narrows it

**The setting:** none needed for most work; a review before merge is the control

**What it costs:** a reviewer's time

**Tier after:** setting

## In the mandates

- **wanted** by [A coding assistant on my machine](../../../map/mandates/coding-assistant-on-my-machine/index.md)
